svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Source Sans 3', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Three panels. Panel I: an amber arrow turns from m₀ to the perpendicular m₁, sweeping a magenta quarter disc; the two end points are two ticks. Panel II: the horizontal axis is the turning angle ωt from 0 to 180°; the dashed curve is the chance of still reading |0⟩ when nobody looks, falling to 0; the cyan sawtooth is the chance when |0⟩ is measured four times, each measurement restarting the fall from the height reached, so that 0.531 is left at 180°. Panel III: the horizontal axis is the inverse temperature β and the curve is the deposit D = ΔE_pass − ΔS/β; left of the critical point β_c it lies below zero (magenta, negative), right of it above zero (cyan, positive).
